d:
A hulking, demonic entity with ash-grey skin and a heavy, muscular build. The head is crown-like with jagged protrusions, featuring glowing amber eyes and a wide, menacing maw. It possesses large, leathery wings with charcoal-grey membranes and a thick, spiked tail ending in a heavy bony club. The four-fingered hands end in sharp, obsidian-black claws.
BODY COLOR: ash-grey
